FEAT4-ST-012.title: Handle Missing or Invalid NPI Responses
FEAT4-ST-012.description: Implement error handling and fallback behavior when NPI Registry returns no results, partial data, or malformed responses, ensuring safe and consistent output to downstream consumers.

FEAT4-ST-013.title: Normalize Provider Address and Credential Data
FEAT4-ST-013.description: Standardize formatting for provider addresses, specialties, and credentials returned from NPI data to ensure consistent display and downstream usability.

FEAT4-ST-014.title: Integrate URL Validation for External Links
FEAT4-ST-014.description: Pass generated state board and research URLs through URL guardian validation to ensure links are live, safe, and properly formatted before returning to users.

FEAT4-ST-015.title: Add Lightweight Caching for NPI Lookup Responses
FEAT4-ST-015.description: Implement short-lived caching of NPI lookup results to reduce redundant external API calls and improve response latency for repeated queries.
FEAT4-ST-015.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No explicit caching exists in provider_detail_service; adding in-memory or TTL cache aligns with existing performance patterns (e.g., URL cache in url_guardian). GAP: Confirm caching strategy standard.
